dynamic_hash_procedure.status: DEFINED, NOT EXECUTED (no trajectory is computed to obtain future hashes)
dynamic_hash_procedure.hash_function: OP-8 array_sha: sha256(str(shape) + little-endian float64 bytes, C order)
dynamic_hash_procedure.link_rule: s >= 2: given_in_sha(s) == next_given_sha(s - 1) and companion_in_sha(s) == next_companion_sha(s - 1) of the SAME trajectory journal (OP-8 records input_link_bitwise); s = 1: given_in_sha and companion_in_sha == this manifest
dynamic_hash_procedure.binding_P_a: a second run of the row in a separate process reproduces every recorded value bitwise (QA-EB item 3 pattern); the comparison is made against the first run's journal, never against expected numbers
dynamic_hash_procedure.before_the_run: every s = 1 input recomputed and compared with this manifest; a mismatch is BLOCKED_CAMPAIGN (protocol 4.4)
dynamic_hash_procedure.platform_note: the s = 1 hashes depend on numpy's sin (start set): valid on the platform recorded in 'hash_platform' only

rule.selected_by: features of the row only (block, family, level, n_x, n_y, s); no value of any computation is read
rule.SP-RH: R-H direct with its own exact-residual bound: block A rows with (n_x - 1)(n_y - 1) <= 4096 (the 11 grids of protocol 5 item 9), s = 1, 2, 3
rule.SP-LARGE: large grids: exact A, B, C, F against the doubles and the exact residual R-HP with certified lambda_low: block A level-4 grids of the 7 families and the anisotropic grids with (n_x - 1)(n_y - 1) > 4096, s = 1, 2, 3
rule.SP-GAMMA: exact gamma_s by a different path (VOK-2 identity, energies_path_b, or the 13-point form a_h) against [gamma_down, gamma_up] of B1: SP-RH union SP-LARGE
rule.SP-BR: certified reference BR for the B-C solution: SP-RH union SP-LARGE
rule.SP-C: exact rational C from the stored binary64 set (reference) and variant CONTROL in double (D-054.3 item 2): SP-RH union SP-LARGE
rule.SP-BE: separate recount of B_E (recommendation, sect. 9): level-1 grids of the 7 families and the anisotropic pair (61, 37), (37, 61); s = 2, 3 (both fields of the row nonzero)
rule.block_D: R-H on every block-D N = 1 row (protocol 5 item 9): PENDING the geometry (OD-1); (14, 6), N = 3 blocked (PRE_D1_RANK)

second_path.status: PROPOSAL fixed by rule before any D1 result; adoption OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED (OD-11)

owner_decisions.topic: geometry (l_x, l_y) of block D (OP-3; protocol 3, 12.3)
owner_decisions.proposal: l_x = l_y = 1 for (9, 11), (11, 15), (14, 6) (as the anisotropic grids 2.3: every input exact, h_x != h_y by construction)
owner_decisions.alternative: l_x = 1, l_y = fl(n_y/n_x) (h_x ~ h_y; fl inexact for 11/9, 15/11, 3/7)

owner_decisions.topic: infinity norm of the set for N >= 2 (form BC-1; protocol 5.1, 12.3)
owner_decisions.proposal: max |V_ij| over all entries of the solved set (n_s - 1) x N in the basis U~ after QR, the basis recorded
owner_decisions.alternative: max over the nodes of the field |(U~ V^T)_ij| (basis-independent)

owner_decisions.topic: path and inputs of the paired half-steps of block C (protocol 3.1, 12.3)
owner_decisions.proposal: R-AC chain r5_cccc_sequence.run_sequence(SequenceConfig(1.0, n_x, fl(r), n_y, N, D, q, s_max=8, first='Y', qr=True)) on the 7 level-2 grids, stored NPZ hashed before the paired run; paired B-C by the EQ functions bc_input, run_halfstep, solve_c3plus (blob of scripts/r5_cccc_q4_energy_bc_audit.py), single-threaded (solve_c3plus replaces bc.bc_coefficients globally); N = 2, 3 only after PRE_D1_RANK is resolved

G-1 sign of gamma: second path SP-GAMMA (E1/E2 do not see it: Gamma_up = |gamma|); G-2 gamma of another half-step: binding P-a + SP-GAMMA; G-3 Q^ from another d^: binding P-a (d^ hash) + E2; G-4 energy of the wrong field: binding P-a + E1/E2; G-5 a term of B_E dropped: SP-BE recount only

owner_decisions.topic: conditions of PL 6.3 for a B-C row (12.3, 12.5)
owner_decisions.proposal: RAM of the machine = total physical memory (GlobalMemoryStatusEx); peak = peak working set of the row process; 'factorization' = wall time of each stage containing a factorization (OP-8 B-C half-step; BR: exact assembly, decimal Cholesky ladder, refinement, lambda_low) <= 30 min each; 'refinement converges' = BR refine_converged and a certified lambda_low (BR's own rule)

owner_decisions.proposal: the classifier of protocol 4 knows only P-a...P-f; a row whose C-3+ premises are UNRESOLVED or whose exact bound check fails needs a declared status (e.g. UNRESOLVED_CERTIFICATE with reason 'C-3+') - the protocol is silent
